keyFindings.description: The close's and the repair's block-state writes leave a closed issue's document live ahead of its latest version (state is rendered, pmdoc/schema.go:377; no settlement runs while closed), and #2210's block index skips a document owed an index that is live ahead (pending && markdown != stored) until it reopens. Migration 0121 marks every document owed and the boot repair (main.go:286) runs before the loop (main.go:422), so on the deploy that ships both, every closed issue the repair writes, and every issue this release closes before its documents are indexed, gets no block graph until it reopens; rebuild-refs (refs/rebuild.go:97) re-marks every document owed, so the same happens after any rebuild for every closed issue whose close wrote a block state. Their #b- references resolve to no node (refs/graph.go), search links ?ask= instead of #b-, and owed_documents never reaches 0. Fix: index a live-ahead document of a closed issue at its latest version's stored rendering, whose blocks are that version's own.
